name: CryptoLab
tagline: A physical low-power blockchain whose nodes agree on blocks through light signals instead of mining.
problem: Proof-of-work blockchains burn huge amounts of energy on puzzles that exist only to make consensus costly.
solution: Microcontroller nodes with LEDs and light sensors: a leader emits a seed-derived blink pattern, neighbours sample it as an attestation step, and blocks finalize without mining.
demo_moment: Team-described: watch the nodes blink and a block finalize.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of Blockchain” among 85 submissions.
Rethinks consensus physically rather than in software alone.

lessons: Making an abstract protocol physical makes it demonstrable.
